name: Wedding Cake 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable
description:
Lineage: Triangle Kush x Animal Mints 

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, D-Limonene, ß-Myrcene 

Aroma: Sweet, Pepper, Vanilla 

Effects: Calming, Appetite Stimulating, Happy

Step into the enchanting aroma of Wedding Cake, where blissful unions of sweet and earthy notes create a symphony for your senses. This indulgent strain is a celebration in every bud, offering a delightful experience reminiscent of a decadent dessert table at a joyous occasion. With its rich flavor profile and uplifting effects, Wedding Cake is a toast to euphoria and relaxation. Elevate your senses and join the celebration with Wedding Cake, where every puff is a flavorful journey down the aisle of serenity.
